messages:
leila (evals): Heads-up: onboarding holly-v1-q6 shows weird parenthesis/bracket reordering in mixed CJK+Hebrew shortctx evals. chrF down ~0.08 on subset. :confused:
mina (eng-ml): can you paste a tiny repro?
leila (evals): short example below. note the parentheses around the chapter number flip side and the Hebrew closing bracket attaches to the CJK token in q6 output.
```
src: "第(3)章 — פרק(3) \n"
ref: "第(3)章 — פרק(3)"
holly-v1-fp16: "第(3)章 — פרק(3)"
holly-v1-q6: "第 (3) 章 — \u200fפרק(3)"
```
ben (quant): interesting. q6 export applied aggressive token merge + unicode-normalize=NFKC + digit_anchor RTL heuristic. That LRMARK (\u200f) before Hebrew and the extra spaces are suspicious.
oscar (serving): runtime canary logs: decoder warnings `kv_index_misaligned id=0 seq=7 expected=28 got=24` on that request id. Also observed dropped token at seq boundary.
leila (evals): token dump: fp16 tokens: ['第','(','3',')','章',' ','—',' ','פרק','(','3',')'] q6 tokens: ['第',' ','(','3',')',' ','章',' ','—',' ','\u200fפרק','(','3',')']
mina (eng-ml): so q6 inserted ascii-space inside CJK token cluster and prepended RTL mark to the Hebrew token, causing token boundary shift. That explains alignment warnings (kv offsets off by a few bytes).
ben (quant): likely culprit: token minifier combined with NFKC canonicalization moves punctuation into different codepoints (fullwidth vs halfwidth). We have a fallback that tries to anchor numerals into surrounding script; it may be misclassifying the CJK bracket boundary after normalization.
tara (infra): export CI shows: holly-v1 -> q6 (minify_tok=true, nfkc=true, anchor_digits=rtl) SUCCESS at 3112300001. No pipeline errors.
mina (eng-ml): mitigation: pause q6 rollout for holly-v1 in us-west-2 and eu-central while we triage. Can we route new requests to fp16?
oscar (serving): done. routing flipped to fp16 for holly-v1 in those regions at 3112300035. I'll also enable extra logging of token_id->kv_offset for mixed-script requests.
ben (quant): plan: 1) reproduce locally with token minifier disabled to confirm; 2) run bisect on nfkc vs nfkc_disabled vs anchor_digits toggle; 3) add unit test for bracket handling around CJK+RTL boundaries. ETA 3-4h for a hotfix.
leila (evals): I'll run focused subtitle-like eval subset (CJK chapter headers + RTL translations) to quantify delta and rerun after hotfix.
mina (eng-ml): please also check tokenizer binary checksum embedded in export artifacts. We had a case where an older token table slipped into minified builds.
ben (quant): good call. i'll verify checksums and sync tokens.
notify-bot: Canary rollback: holly-v1-q6 routing -> fp16 (us-west-2, eu-central) executed by oscar at 3112300036
leila (evals): TL;DR: holly-v1-q6 causes paren/bracket spacing and bidi mark insertion at CJK+Hebrew boundary; kv alignment warnings observed; rollback applied. Action items: bisect export transforms (ben), run focused eval subset (leila), add token<->kv logging (oscar).
mina (eng-ml): thanks. ping here when bisect lands and when subset metrics available, we'll decide on a safe re-rollout path. :thumbsup:
